verdict: Organic profiles are the only active source — and all three are slowing.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid campaigns on Meta and Google ran zero spend and produced zero leads, leaving your Google Business Profile listings as the sole source of inbound activity. Combined, the three profiles generated 367 actions over the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — but all three profiles have dropped sharply in the most recent seven days, with declines ranging from 35% to 79% week over week. The most significant drop is at O'Hare Precision, where GBP actions have registered zero for five consecutive days and search clicks have also pulled back. We are reviewing each profile's visibility and content to address the engagement decline, and paid campaign activity is being evaluated to restore a second lead source so organic slowdowns don't leave the business fully exposed.

watch_item.issue: All three GBP profiles are declining simultaneously in the most recent week, with no paid campaigns active to compensate — the business has a single point of failure for inbound leads right now.
watch_item.fix: Profile content and visibility are being reviewed across all three locations this week, and paid campaign reactivation is under active evaluation to restore a parallel lead source.
